messages:
Priya Shah: quick sprint sync — token throughput +18% WoW, QoQ +32%. Avg P95 latency 310ms (was 220ms last week). 5xx error rate jumped 0.9% -> 2.3% around 03:20 UTC. Spend +27% QoQ; largest contributor: org 'Lexicon' (lots of long-chat sessions, >8k tokens). Dashboard: https://redwood.app/d/ops/token-usage?org=lexicon
Gabe Chen: thanks. heads-up — Lexicon renewal in 2 weeks. if this trend keeps, they could hit overage and flag for downgrade/contingency. Can we get quick fix + a customer-friendly mitigation plan? :thinking_face:
Marta Li: looking. early signal points to KV-cache misses when context >6k — combined with a model variant bump they did on Wed. I can try a prefix caching hotfix and pin model variant for them.
Marta Li: quick diagnostic query I ran: ```sql
SELECT bin(1m, timestamp) as ts, count(*) as reqs, avg(latency_ms) as p95, sum(case when status >=500 then 1 else 0 end) as errs
FROM request_logs
WHERE org = 'lexicon' AND timestamp > ago(24h)
GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY ts DESC
LIMIT 100
```
Jamal Rodriguez: I chatted with Lexicon CSM — they rolled out a multi-step generator for summaries last Tue which increased average sequence length. They're open to an enablement session and would prefer not to switch to Dedicated yet. They asked if batching + caching could be a temp fix.
OnboardingBot: Created ticket CS-4723: "Lexicon unexpected token ramp — enablement + short-term routing/caching" assigned to @Marta Li and @Gabe Chen.
Gabe Chen: action items: 1) Marta -> hotfix prefix caching + pin variant (monitor 6h). 2) I'll draft a cost-neutral mitigation (e.g., burst buffer + temporary quota bump, plus clear spend dashboard view) for renewal touchpoint. 3) Jamal -> schedule enablement & collect exact prompt flows.
Priya Shah: plan sounds good. Marta, can you estimate ETA for the hotfix rollout? If we can get <4h to prod, we should cut the spike fast. :eyes:
Marta Li: ETA ~2.5h to staged rollout, 1h monitoring window. will deploy canary @ 1858004200 and roll if no regressions.
Jamal Rodriguez: booked enablement Tue 10:00 PT with Lexicon engineers. I'll capture example prompts and token counts and share in the ticket.
Priya Shah: perfect. Gabe — please include a short summary for renewal email (impact, mitigation, ask). We'll reconvene EOD with status. :thumbsup:
